subject: Renewal paperwork: uplift sequencing and signpath orchestration
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-22T09:15:00Z
Subject: Renewal paperwork: uplift sequencing and signpath orchestration

Team — attaching the latest redlines from NovaBio and our proposed order form. Key points: 
- Commercial: 18-month renewal with a phased incremental capacity ladder (Q1 +25%, Q2 +25%, Q3 +50%). We agreed to a one-time overlap credit of $18k to cover proration during migration.
- Legal: NovaBio pushed back on the standard indemnity carve (Section 8) and retention length for request logs (Section 12). I’ve marked these in the attached MSA redline.
- Signing path I propose: Procurement (NovaBio) -> GC (NovaBio) -> Redwood Legal -> Redwood CEO (final exec sign). We can template a DocuSign flow to enforce order.

Ask: Laura/Kim — can you review the attached MSA redline and confirm whether we can accept the narrower indemnity language proposed in red (or provide counter wording)? Ben — need confirmation on the overlap credit accounting so I can include it in the order form.

Attachments (stubs): MSA_NovaBio_v4_redline.docx (docx), OrderForm_NovaBio_v3_clean.pdf (pdf), MutualActionPlan_NovaBio.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Renewals Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-22T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: uplift sequencing and signpath orchestration

Thanks, Tessa — quick read and a few flags: 
1) Section 8 (Indemnity): NovaBio’s suggested narrowing removes our third-party IP carve for customer-provided data. We should not accept wholesale; propose alternate limited-liability cap tied to fees for the prior 12 months.
2) Section 12 (Retention): They request 6 months for request logs — our standard is 24 months for auditability. Can we offer 12 months for request logs while keeping 24 months for security/audit logs? That’s a reasonable middle ground.
3) SLA credits: language in the order form about credit stacking conflicts with our SLO philosophy; recommend explicit single-credit remedy and clarify calculation.

Can you add a clean (no redline) MSA and a clean order form for DocuSign after we settle wording? I'll draft exact counterlanguage if we want to push.

Laura Bennett
Legal Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Patel <maya@novabio.com>
Date: 2028-05-23T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: uplift sequencing and signpath orchestration

Looping in the commercial brief and MAP.
- Confirming the overlap credit: $18,000 applied pro rata across Q1 invoice; finance OK with credit as a contra revenue line. I’ll prepare an invoice sample for procurement.
- On SLA credits: we can accept the single-credit remedy Laura suggests; I’ll update the order form wording and include a worked example for NovaBio to avoid confusion.

Maya — can you confirm the procurement signer and whether procurement will need a PO number before DocuSign? If NovaBio requires a PO, we should align signpath timing.

Attachment: MutualActionPlan_NovaBio.xlsx (contains signers, milestones, and dates)

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@gc-novabio.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Patel <maya@novabio.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-24T16:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: uplift sequencing and signpath orchestration

Ben / team — thanks for the note. From NovaBio’s side: 
- Procurement: we will sign through procurement first. PO will be issued and must be referenced on the order form. We can provide the PO within 48 hrs of countersignature.
- Indemnity: NovaBio cannot accept broad third-party IP indemnity tied to customer-provided models; we propose the alternative at the bottom of our redline (short, mutual IP indemnity with carveouts for open-source).
- Retention: we are comfortable with 12 months for request logs; we will not agree to 24 months.

If Redwood can accept the 12-month compromise (for request logs) and revise indemnity to the mutual language in our redline, we can route for signature this week via DocuSign. I’ve attached a pointer to our procurement contact for the PO flow.

Procurement point: procurement@novabio.com

Regards,
Evan Liu
General Counsel (outside counsel for NovaBio)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@novabio.com>, Evan Liu <evan.liu@gc-novabio.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-25T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: uplift sequencing and signpath orchestration

Thanks all — concise next steps to close this week: 
1) Legal alignment (Laura/Kim): Laura to send counterlanguage for Section 8 indemnity by EOD 05-25. If accepted, Laura to produce clean MSA and Order Form for DocuSign.
2) Commercial (Ben/Tessa): Ben to add PO field and the overlap credit line item to the clean order form; Tessa to update MAP and schedule signpath.
3) NovaBio procurement: Maya/Evan to confirm PO issuance timing and signer names. NovaBio indicated PO within 48 hrs of countersignature; please confirm earlier if available.
4) DocuSign: once clean docs are ready, we'll use this envelope: https://www.docusign.net/envelope/ABC123456789 (placeholder). Proposed signer order: Procurement -> GC -> Redwood Legal -> Redwood CEO.

I attached the clean order form (OrderForm_NovaBio_v3_clean.pdf) to test the DocuSign pre-fill and the MAP. If legal posts counterlanguage that’s acceptable we’ll convert to envelope and push to NovaBio procurement.

Attachments referenced: OrderForm_NovaBio_v3_clean.pdf, MutualActionPlan_NovaBio.xlsx

Tessa Morgan
Sr. Renewals Manager
Redwood Inference
